apps.short_description: Fling your flock up a field of crops and watch them ricochet. Crossbreed wild hybrids, chase 23 legendary sheep, beat six bosses and outrun the weeds, alone or with a friend on the same screen. Then head home and grow your farm.

apps.name: Bad House
apps.short_description:
Welcome to your new home. The previous tenant left some things. You can have them, but there's just one condition: don’t go into the basement.
Explore the many rooms of a mysterious basement in Bad House, an auto-battler dungeon crawler.

apps.name: Bad Shrooms
apps.short_description: Violent first-person party games for 2 to 4 players inside an alien's apartment. Bowl with guns, turn tiny in a house full of lava, run from Crazy Randy through the bathrooms. One couch or online. It all ends with eggs.

apps.name: Battlegenics
apps.short_description: A unique roguelike word fusing mutant breeding game! Fuse the monsters and the words into one creature. Form an army of mutants and battle the world! Or play with a friend and fuse parts together.

apps.name: Bearing: Zer0Zer0
apps.short_description: Bearing: ZER0ZER0 is a first-person submarine PvPvE game for crews of 1-8 or more with up to 32 player controlled Submarines: listen at the hydrophone, raise the scope, wind the firing solution and sink them before they sink you.

apps.name: Bee Space
apps.short_description: Plant flowers and deploy tech from orbit in this roguelike deckbuilder! Terraform tiny hex grid islands as advanced space Bees. Contend with fickle weather, strange creatures, mysterious artifacts and meddling bosses as you reclaim Earth for all Bee-Kind!

apps.name: better.game
apps.short_description: A game without lag or ping advantage. Simply better. Moving spherical zone. Build ramps, walls, floors and cones, edit through them, fight, or just go to zone. Jetpack, glide, grapple, ascend, teleport or drive across the map. Die, view an in-game replay, then reboot and get back in the fight.

apps.name: Billiard Cat
apps.short_description: Cats love knocking things off tables. What if it's a pool table? Missed a shot? A cat might just nudge the ball in for you. Then again, it might get in your way. Between turns, pet them, play with a cat teaser, or let one nap on your lap. 8-ball, 9-ball, and snooker for up to 4 players.

apps.name: Bit Awakening
apps.short_description: Bit Awakening is a handcrafted 2D action-adventure platformer set in a story-rich world of eccentric characters, beautiful biomes and buried mysteries. Explore, recover and unravel the secrets of a civilization where nature clashes with relentless industry.

apps.name: Bobby - Pixel indie platformer
apps.short_description:
You can't trust anything in this game! Every step you take, you risk losing your head, failing, being burned, eaten, trampled, broken morally and physically.
But don't worry — you won't know it until you take this step!

apps.name: BPM Boy
apps.short_description: BPM Boy is a physics-based platformer, featuring hidden secrets, leaderboards for speed-runners and a funky original soundtrack.

apps.name: Bustbound
apps.short_description: Make 21 your weapon. Bustbound turns blackjack into a roguelike deckbuilder: hit, stand, or double down to win turn-based battles. Combine effect cards and relics, choose your route through six stages, and face the Joker Couple.

apps.name: Can't See Shift
apps.short_description: Can't See Shift is a chaotic 1–4 player co-op road trip. Split control of a battered van: one player steers while another handles the pedals. Navigate procedural rural roads, clear obstacles, repair the van, and try to reach the wedding in one piece.

apps.name: Captive 3000
apps.short_description: Wake from cryosleep on a dying space station prison and guide a remote droid to your own rescue. A lightning-fast, real-time, grid-based dungeon crawler with traditional sprite design. Explore and fight through 50+ hours of handcrafted star bases, then infinite seeded missions. Free demo available.

apps.name: Capture The Wild
apps.short_description: Capture The Wild is a peaceful, immersive experience centered on observation, where you play as a wildlife filmmaker in search of rare footage of animals in the wild. Develop your career over time, evolving from amateur contracts to professional international productions.

apps.name: Cartomantic
apps.short_description: A tactical Tarot roguelite deckbuilder, where positioning matters just as much as the cards themselves. Craft decks of Minor and Major Arcana, create powerful combos, make your power reach the millions, and overcome the formidable Arcana Trials to see what lies within.

apps.name: Celestial Golf
apps.short_description: It’s 2D golf on an astronomical scale. Bite-sized missions will teach you the techniques of real space flight, without having to worry about fuel or crew. Precisely plan orbital trajectories over the moons of Mars, through the rings of Saturn, and boldly go where no golf ball has gone before.

apps.name: Chip Sweeper
apps.short_description: A color-matching falling-blocks puzzle game. Position chips as they fall on the board. Match four colors in a row. Delete every bug before you top out. Play through a story, go against some friends, or chase the high score.

apps.name: Chirp Chirp
apps.short_description: One lost little bird, one big climb back home. Chirp Chirp is a lighthearted precision platformer where every jump, chirp, and butt stomp brings you one flap closer to the warmth of your cozy nest.

apps.name: Chocolate Parade
apps.short_description:
A heavy-weapon battle between the mightiest sweets!
"Chocolate Parade" is a crazy roguelike action game where you roll sweets and unleash heavy weapons!
Players (solo or co-op) can create their own parade and compete for coins on a boss-rush battlefield!

apps.name: City Services
apps.short_description: A co-op comedy for 1–6 players. You're the town's under-qualified public works crew: fix potholes, fallen trees and escaped livestock before the clock runs out, while every dent you put in the town comes out of your paycheck. Try not to run over the townsfolk.

apps.name: Civitas: World Simulator
apps.short_description: Civitas: World Simulator is a deep historical-fantasy simulation where nations will dynamically rise, fall, and evolve. In this game we model internal forces like ethnicity, culture, language and other inner political struggles.

apps.name: Clean vs. Dirty!
apps.short_description: The germs are attacking! Pick up your broom, conquer 30 progressively challenging levels, buy and upgrade cleaning tools, and face the endless wrath of Endless Mode! Every tool has unique perks, range, damage, and attack speed. Can you keep the bathroom clean?

apps.name: Coin Frenzy
apps.short_description: Coin Frenzy is an incremental game about launching coins and growing your rewards. Upgrade coin values, launch more coins, and boost your sectors. Earn skill points, rebirth into the skill tree, and unlock new ways to fill and collect your board

apps.name: COLLAPSE MACHINE 2D
apps.short_description: PvE multiplayer top-down adventure. Lead an armed convoy across industrialized alien planets in search of treasure, tech, power, or escape.

apps.name: County of Fortune
apps.short_description: Build an entire medieval county, not just a city. Found villages across a wide, varied landscape, weave trade along rivers and roads, and guide mayors, noble houses, and cultures as your region comes to life. A city-builder on a much bigger scale, no two counties are alike.

apps.name: Cursor Cult
apps.short_description: A tiny pixel civilization lives on an island at the edge of your screen, and it worships your mouse cursor. Every 20 seconds its priests read your cursor's trail as an omen: farm, build, trade, pray, study, or march to war. Just use your computer; your habits become their scripture.

apps.name: Dark And Me
apps.short_description: A dark, wordless puzzle-platformer in black and white. Guide a small creature with glowing eyes through a deadly forest: push crates, pull levers, swing on ropes, ride rafts, hide from hunters and outrun the Dark across ten chapters and 216 handcrafted rooms.

apps.name: Dead DayZ
apps.short_description: As the preacher stepped out of the barricaded church, the scene he observed sent a shiver down his spine. Armed with weapons, and experience he traversed the small town terrain. Looking for survivors despite the hordes of zombies trickling down to his area.

apps.name: Dead Mosaic
apps.short_description: A shifting machine planet, gone silent. Land on Tessus and figure out what happened to its people, with a story that changes every play-through. This is your chance to clear your debt. But watch your back, something is taking out the lights.

apps.name: DeadHex
apps.short_description: deadHex is a tactical FPS-MOBA where precision aim meets strategic builds. Draft powerful items, wield game-changing artifacts, and hire mercenaries to pressure your opponent’s defenses. Every match is a fast-paced duel of skill, strategy, and ruthless efficiency.

apps.name: DeckWake
apps.short_description: Bring a derelict space station back to life, one deck at a time. DECKWAKE is a first- and third-person sci-fi horror roguelite for solo play or 2–4-player co-op. Descend into sealed decks, bring back what you can carry, and restore power, communications and doors.

apps.name: DeCube
apps.short_description: A nostalgic incremental game where you mine whole planets down to their core. Dig, upgrade and hire workers to uncover the secrets that lie beneath...

apps.name: Desert Cleaner
apps.short_description: Tidy up the oasis! Scoop the desert into your backpack, turn sand into gold and upgrade from a cotton glove to a full-blown sandstorm. Uncover a green oasis, hidden treasure and helpful robots, alone or with up to 3 friends in online co-op.

apps.name: Desimulate
apps.short_description: A turn-based, 1v1 game of logical deduction, prediction and misdirection. Control a crew of twelve aboard an isolated spaceship, or impersonate two of those crew members and eliminate everyone else.

apps.name: Deskside Days
apps.short_description: A little bunny has moved onto your desktop. While you work or study, it lives on a tiny island in the corner of your screen: cooking, fishing, decorating its home, writing to friends and traveling for photos. The island changes with the seasons and barely uses any resources.

apps.name: Desktop Fish Wish
apps.short_description: A cozy idle fishing game that lives on your desktop. While you work or relax, your little angler fishes on a tiny planet in the corner of your screen — catch 100 kinds of fish, fill your collection, dress up, and adopt charming pets.

apps.name: Desktop Guild
apps.short_description: Desktop Guild is an idle village-management and adventurer-training game for your desktop. Recruit heroes, gear up, raid the tower; build shops and a guild from your loot, draw visitors, grow rich, then forge stronger heroes to conquer the tower. Includes a free water-reminder helper~

apps.name: Dice Roller Incremental
apps.short_description: Roll your dice, upgrade them, buy more dice! Dice Roller Incremental is a game where each dice roll earns you money, which you then spend on improving your dice rolls.

apps.name: DICTOCRACY
apps.short_description: Take charge as the President of a newly independent country, Adelphia. Build infrastructure, approve policies, juggle between conflicting priorities of the public, your ministers and other countries' leaders - All with only one action per turn and a different political landscape in each playthrough

apps.name: DISK-Y
apps.short_description:
Let's show〈Yuu〉, the new student, around school.
A short psycho-horror visual novel depicting
a mysterious relationship with her,
unfolding without context like a dream.

The Steam version of an experimental retro game
designed to fit on a single 3.5-inch floppy disk.

apps.name: Dogs Playing Dead
apps.short_description: Dogs Playing Dead is a competitive party game for up to 6 players that is equal parts boardgame, arcade and third-person shooter. Use your quirky character to explore each room of the mansion where diabolical minigames will test your skills. You need the most points to be able to leave the house!

apps.name: Drawmaha
apps.short_description: Private-table draw poker for short, sharp sessions. Invite friends or seat AI. Drawmaha plays out every draw; Stack Rush locks the pot after the flop and raises the pressure. Two boards, fast hands, clubs that keep your regular table intact.

apps.name: Drawmi: Card Shop
apps.short_description: A card shop simulator where you draw all the cards that you sell. Crack open packs, sell cards, host tournaments, and invite your friends to help grow the store.

apps.name: Dungeon Baller
apps.short_description: Pinball meets RPG in this fast-paced roguelike. Launch tiny heroes, battle bumper enemies, and choose your fate through mystery doors. Wield hundreds of powerful items and defeat bosses to reclaim your soul in this retro-inspired reimagining of pinball.

apps.name: Dungeon Stew
apps.short_description: Gather your companions, feed them suspicious stew, and conquer the dungeon! Dungeon Stew is a time-loop roguelite RPG centered on card-based combat. Break the cycle of fate with the knowledge and resources you gather across repeated expeditions!

apps.name: Dynasty of the Sands
apps.short_description: Be the architect of your own Egyptian empire in this meditative survival city builder, where every decision, no matter how small, has lasting consequences. Survive alongside your people, expand your influence across the Nile and create a grand Dynasty to rival the gods themselves. Paradise awaits.

apps.name: Echo Contingency
apps.short_description: Stealth-first co-op infiltration inspired by the golden era of tactical stealth. Master light, sound, and movement in a modern reimagining of classic stealth purism. Fully moddable, fully co-op, and built for players who want stealth precision, not cinematic autopilot.

apps.name: Eighth Pole
apps.short_description: Eighth Pole is a realistic horse racing simulator where you train, race, and breed horses as you build your stable and rise through the ranks of the racing world.

apps.name: ELEVADOOM
apps.short_description: You're the night shift of an elevator that travels down into the memories of a life. Two to four friends, one weight limit and until 6 AM to bring up everything the building asks for. Carry the copier together, dodge the landlord… and don't leave anyone behind. Or do.

apps.name: Emerald Space Courier
apps.short_description: Start your engines and adjust the equalizer! On orders from the ruthless Emerald Corp, transport the most valuable cargo in the galaxy. Brave the chaos of drones, mercenary ships, and giant slimes under crossfire. The true hero of this story is you, Space Courier. Accept the challenge?

apps.name: Endless Loot
apps.short_description: Explore a dark dungeon one tile at a time in a first-person, turn-based loot RPG. Choose which skill books to activate, merge matching gear, and build around set bonuses. Beat the campaign or see how far you can go in Endless mode.

apps.name: ESCAPE: FALSE COLORS
apps.short_description: ESCAPE: FALSE COLORS is a 2–6 player multiplayer chase game! Paint your character, blend into the environment, and take on random roles each round. Killers hunt, sheriffs chase, and innocents fight to survive. Hide, disguise, and run. Who will make it to the end?

apps.name: European Truck Manager
apps.short_description: One truck. One company. Build your transport business across Europe. Hire drivers, manage your fleet, take on jobs and expand your operations. From your first delivery to a growing logistics network, every decision shapes your company's future. You write your own story.

apps.name: Everything Simulator
apps.short_description: Choose a world and explore it. Walk the volcanic plains of Venus and fly from the ground to orbit, swim and dive across an ocean planet, or ride mine carts through old tunnels alone or online with friends. Three worlds, one simulator, no limits.

apps.name: Fall of Booty: Waifu Warfare
apps.short_description: A loud, dirty-minded anime arena shooter. Pick a girl, dress her up, and fight across five maps in Team Deathmatch, Free for All and Capture Points, online with friends through Steam or against bots. Twelve ridiculous kill streaks. Every character is a fictional adult.

apps.name: Farm Island
apps.short_description: Turn a tiny patch of land into a living island farm. Grow 20 crops, give residents a home, and let them help with harvesting and watering. Make flour, bread and preserves, fulfil deliveries, and shape your island through four changing seasons.

apps.name: Fighters on Stream
apps.short_description: Fighters on Stream is a chaotic pixel-art auto-battler for livestream audiences. Customize your own fighter and bring them into other streamers’ battles by joining through chat. Watch them fight for victory as weapons and unexpected random events turn the tide!

apps.name: Finding Frankie 2
apps.short_description: Trapped inside a deadly televised game show, you must parkour through a massive obstacle complex. Wall run, rail grind, and vault past twisted traps in the final season. Win the $10 million prize, or die trying. Frankie is waiting for you and he’s not holding back.

apps.name: Five Star Crew
apps.short_description: Run a tour boat with up to three friends through waters full of deadly sea life. Steer, cook, patch leaks and protect your guests on the way to the next dock. They paid for five-star service. Try to keep them alive long enough to leave a review.

apps.name: Flickly Cat
apps.short_description: Flickly Cat is a desktop creature idler. Collect over hundreds of cute silly creatures and play with them with your mouse and toys.

apps.name: For The Kingdom
apps.short_description: Forge your own legend in an endless medieval fantasy world built from a seed. Chop, mine, farm, brew, cook and craft your way up over a dozen skills, tame wild horses and hatch slime pets, build a home, and invite friends through Steam. Your character goes with you to every world.

apps.name: FotFoot
apps.short_description: Run a football club your way: sign stars, set your tactics and change the game from the touchline as the big moments play out live on a 2D pitch. Over 4,200 clubs, 110,000 players and 158 countries, from the lowest divisions to the world stage, in a world that never stops moving.

apps.name: Frostward
apps.short_description: Frostward is a turn-based 4X survival strategy game set on a frozen hex world, where you plan districts, work toward monumental Wonders, command armies in battle, and decide whether humanity will endure, escape, or restore warmth to the world.

apps.name: Fun World
apps.short_description: Explore the Nightmares of Fun World — a once-cheerful children’s park that has fallen into ruin, now twisted and corrupted by dark forces beyond understanding. What was once filled with laughter and bright colors is now drenched in shadows, echoing with distant sounds you can’t quite explain.

apps.name: Gate & Grit: Motocross Tycoon
apps.short_description: Build the motocross venue of your dreams. Shape the track, host lively race days, welcome fans, and grow a little patch of dirt into a racing destination in this cozy, miniature-world management game.

apps.name: GearSpire
apps.short_description: Swap a part, and your deck, your robot's look, and its moves all change. Climb a tower of floating islands with a tiny pilot and a junky robot in this deckbuilding roguelike. Chain cards from different parts to build Sync, then unleash a Full Burst where every part fires its move in turn!

apps.name: Goeland: Seagull Adventure
apps.short_description: You're a seagull. The island is your playground. Everyone on it is your problem to solve, bother, or befriend. Explore freely, solve things your way, mess with everything, and create absurd moments worth sharing.

apps.name: Golden Trivia Show
apps.short_description: Enter a quiz show solo or with friends. Divide your gold bars among the possible answers; those placed on a wrong answer will fall into a piranha pool. Will you make it to the end?

apps.name: Golf Course Architect Tycoon
apps.short_description: Build a golf course on raw land, then watch a full field of golfers play it. See where they struggle, reshape the hole and watch again, all while you run the club growing around it. No grid: sculpt the terrain and paint every surface by hand.

apps.name: Good Coffee, Great Coffee
apps.short_description: Ready to settle in with a soothing shift behind the counter? Master your coffee-making skills while serving quirky customers in this fun and cozy cafe cooking game. Good Coffee, Great Coffee is the ultimate cozy escape for coffee lovers!

apps.name: Granny Remake 2
apps.short_description: Survive a terrifying farm in this co-op multiplayer horror! Hide in cornfields, solve procedural puzzles, and escape before the nightmarish Grandparents find you. Or, play as the killers and hunt your friends down in asymmetrical PvP madness. No two escapes are ever the same.

apps.name: Grave Of Voices
apps.short_description: Ryan Morgan, a 21-year-old horror vlogger, thought he had found the perfect lead for his next video. But when he enters Ashfall, a town erased from the map, he realizes he's trapped in the catacombs below. To escape, he must solve puzzles, scavenge, hide from inhuman creatures, and fight to survive.

apps.name: Grey Havok's Crystal War
apps.short_description:
Grey Havok's Crystal War is a chaotic arcade FPS where you defend crystals from monster waves. Play solo, local split-screen, 1P vs 2P, or Steam online while unlocking levels, chasing scores, grabbing power-
  ups, and customizing characters and guns.

apps.name: Grill Chefs - Restaurant Simulator
apps.short_description: Build your restaurant from scratch, chop ingredients, cook meals, and keep up with the orders! Play solo or online with up to 6 players. In this physics-based kitchen, being a good chef matters. Being a good friend is entirely optional.

apps.name: Happy Village: The Broken Timeline
apps.short_description: A narrative RPG of three intertwined stories, hidden secrets, and a broken timeline only the player can repair. Every ending reveals new paths, if you know where to look.

apps.name: Hell Worlds Reinvigorated
apps.short_description: A necromantic named Cyris leaves his homeworld for a strange odyssey through unknown realms, each one more horrible and bizarre than the next. Use your necromancer abilities to save the earth realm in this retro FPS filled to the brim with fantasy & mystery.

apps.name: Hentai Tales: Steamy Cat Girl Sisters
apps.short_description:
I inherited my grandmother’s old hot-spring inn, only to find two catgirl sisters awaiting me—Yukine and Yukine. 
In this secluded world, I become their new “Master,” and our relationship quickly evolves into something far more intimate and passionate than mere innkeeping.

apps.name: Heroes Never Rest
apps.short_description: Start with a small guild and build a legendary legacy. Recruit heroes, send them on quests, explore new biomes, and unlock new ways to grow stronger. Optimize your strategy, push your limits, and work your way toward becoming the greatest guildmaster of all time.

apps.name: Hexrite
apps.short_description: You are a sorcerer seeking to fulfil a magical ritual to summon an ancient dead deity. Cast mystical domes, explore fantastical realms and meet a peculiar cast of characters in this stylized PS2-inspired action-platformer!

apps.name: Hokko Spaces
apps.short_description: Hokko Spaces is a calm, casual sandbox that gives you fun tools to create beautiful, lively spaces inhabited by adorable characters. Unlock cute residents and watch them hang out, do some gardening, and enjoy the spaces you build for them. No rules, no stress, just cozy dioramas and chill vibes.

apps.name: Hopwood
apps.short_description: A cozy 2D metroidvania about memory. Explore five connected regions, gain a new ability in every act, use the Whisper to hear what creatures think, win back the Old Cherry's five blossoms from bosses who forgot who they are, and uncover the valley's lost story.

apps.name: Hordes of Necromancy
apps.short_description: Hordes of Necromancy is the third game in the Hands of Necromancy series. This time, the gameplay aggressively focuses on large hordes which the player destroys by packing even more power!

apps.name: Horror Stories: Social Problems
apps.short_description: Life simulation and psychological horror. Meet ALISA. Rebuild your life, find a job, explore the town, do anything for her...

apps.name: I'll Pay Tomorrow
apps.short_description: A real-time management game. You're the new caretaker of a run-down hostel, on a 14-day trial: decide who gets a room from what you see at the desk, collect rent door to door at night, fix what breaks, and choose how dirty your hands get.

apps.name: ICE Wars
apps.short_description: 3v3 vehicle combat on the rain-soaked streets of East Los Angeles. Advocates race to get families to safe houses while ICE races to reach them first. Ram, shoot and outdrive the other team in a fight for every passenger, where every delivery decides who gets to stay.

apps.name: idle koi!
apps.short_description: Hatch koi eggs, breed unique bloodlines, evolve rare traits, and send 3-koi teams into idle battles. Build a living collection where genes, rarity, lineage, and battle growth decide every koi's value.

apps.name: Incredibug
apps.short_description: Become the Incredibug: Control a cute pill bug, unite your fellow critters and rise up against a menacing smart home system in this physics-based platformer with metroidvania elements. Play together with a friend as Lumi the firefly in single-screen couch-coop.

apps.name: Infinite Loop: Incremental
apps.short_description: A purely minimalist, text-based idle incremental game! Focused on time management and strategic planning, carefully prioritize your action queue under strict time limits. Death is inevitable, but every loop makes you stronger. Build your automation routines and break the infinite loop!

apps.name: Interplanetary Farmer
apps.short_description: Demand runs ahead of supply, growers are being recruited. You are one of them: you pick a planet, take over a plot of land, and run it remotely through a tracked robot called the Farmoton. You make money (nibs) by growing crops and selling them to the traders who dock at your farm's market each day.

apps.name: Invoker Tactics: Conquest
apps.short_description: A turn-based strategy RPG combining chess-like grid combat, army building, and a unique unit-merging mechanic. Outplay your enemies through strategic positioning and creative combos. Discover your own playstyle as you recruit new units and expand your kingdom.

apps.name: JapaneseDialect
apps.short_description: Japanese Dialects: Words You'll Want to Use

apps.name: Joust Couch
apps.short_description: An action roguelite about jousting on the family couch and learning to grow up. Charge through medieval armies, pirate fleets and Wild West outlaws, aim your lance at full tilt, and strike hard: the faster you ride, the harder you hit. Earn powers, choose gear and ride again when the night resets.

apps.name: Just Dying
apps.short_description: A Roguelite survivor starring streamers. Rescue your followers to stay off the unemployment line, unlock unique characters, stack powerful runes, and become a wrecking ball of total chaos. Learn. Die. Repeat.

apps.name: Kaiju Krush
apps.short_description: Grow from a tiny kaiju into a city-crushing colossus. Smash buildings, recruit hatchlings and spend your spoils on mutations. Molt for permanent Evolutions, unlock optional automation and tear through 15 districts to the Skybreak Citadel.

apps.name: Keep Looking Up
apps.short_description: A calm space exploration game about going further, documenting what you find and sharing it. Jump through an endless galaxy, catch alien species and study them in your ship's labs: bench, microscope, autopsy, DNA, terrarium. The first to name a discovery keeps the credit, forever.

apps.name: KERO CORP
apps.short_description: Welcome to Kero Corp. In this typing-based incremental game, you hire froggy operators to generate passive income. Type nonstop, stack efficiency, automate production, and then prestige to push the system harder. Never Stop Typing.

apps.name: Kick
apps.short_description: Kick is a nostalgic tale of making your way to school, all the while honing your soccer skills throughout challenging levels packed with unique challenges. Do you have what it takes to Kick it?

apps.name: Kick The Dungeon
apps.short_description: Kick the Dungeon is a card-based tactical roguelike game based on the Uses the 5E SRD rules. Assemble a unique party, tailor your own build, and enjoy the thrill of combat. Use cards to cast familiar spells like Fireball and Magic Missile — every run offers a different experience.

apps.name: KICKDOWN: Highway Traffic Racing
apps.short_description: Floor it and thread the gap. Weave through dense highway traffic, chain near misses into combos and outrun the police in 7 regions by day, sunset, rain and night. Play 9 modes to earn, upgrade and customize your cars.

apps.name: Kifu Garden
apps.short_description: Tiny companions carry Go (Weiqi / Baduk) stones, one move at a time. Watch classic game records unfold in a living pixel garden, shape their little home, and discover 100 companion species. Import your own SGF files and settle into a gentle idle sandbox with changing days, weather, and seasons.

apps.name: kitty Limited Trade Union
apps.short_description: Run a guild of cats in this pixel-art incremental game. Hunt monsters with clicks or recruit cats to fight for you. Earn gold, plan your talents, mix drinks and forge weapons as your guild grows with each rebirth.

apps.name: KUBIKA
apps.short_description: KUBIKA is a Sokoban-like puzzle adventure. Manipulate gravity and guide charming little cubes across three-dimensional, perspective-twisting puzzles. Master each world’s unique mechanics, build and share your own puzzles using the built-in Level Editor. Free Demo available today !

apps.name: L'Eternel Retour, Death Gamble
apps.short_description: A bullet heaven roguelite. Caught in a loop of death and return, hold back a surging horde, draft a build, and find a way to save what's left of civilization. Die, come back, unlock new items and weapons. Solo or online co-op.

apps.name: Last Floor: Paradox
apps.short_description:
An elevator that doesn't obey the laws of space.
Descend through impossible places, spot anomalies, follow the rules, and survive whatever waits on the Last Floor.

apps.name: Last Harbor
apps.short_description: Zombie Apocalypse On A Boat. You’re stranded on a boat during a zombie outbreak in the beautiful San Juan islands of Washington State. How will you survive an open-world archipelago, where the living are just as much of a threat as the dead?

apps.name: Last One Employed
apps.short_description: A cutthroat party card game for 3–10 players. Sabotage your coworkers, survive your inbox, and be the last one employed. One shared screen; phones are the controllers.

apps.name: Leeway: Lightkeeper
apps.short_description: The lighthouse has reopened after years, and you are the strait's only watchman. Ships are lining up: read their papers, verify the data, talk over the radio, and decide who gets through. A quiet job in clear weather. Not once the rain starts, and you can't trust your instruments either.

apps.name: Legion's Hand
apps.short_description: Legion's Hand is a mahjong-inspired roguelike deckbuilder. Match three identical cards to form a Giant Soldier, or a sequence to form a Regiment. Your hand shapes your army and its formation. Collect 190+ rule-changing relics and send your winning hand into battle.

apps.name: Let's Build Together
apps.short_description: Build up to 859,436 pieces in a single map, solo or with up to 8 friends. Unlock powerful upgrades, automate construction with helpers, and turn empty plots into finished buildings in this cozy first-person building game.

apps.name: Leviticus
apps.short_description: Leviticus is a bullet hell sci-fi action indie game where you play as a biblically accurate angel sent to guard those made in the image of GOD. you patrol the stars and destroy alien intruders that aren't made in his image. Fight across space, uncover and enforce Heaven’s decree.

apps.name: LEXICON: Lingua Obscura
apps.short_description: A word based puzzle game where you twist strange rules, uncover hidden patterns, and solve clever linguistic challenges that always feel one step away from revealing something bigger.

apps.name: Little Guy Friday
apps.short_description: Enter the Uncool Underground and face the Leet 14 in this irreverent creature collecting roguelike! Gather your ragtag team of silly Little Guys and guide them towards ascension... or just crash out and try another run!

apps.name: LocoMo
apps.short_description: LocoMo is a cozy city builder and living-world sandbox where you play as the village itself. Build a living world where thousands of customizable tiny villagers travel, play, and socialize. Grow towns, design routes, and connect it all with paths, trains, boats, and planes.

apps.name: Lode Builder
apps.short_description: Lode Builder is the evolution of the classic Lode Runner. Collect all the gold using new tactical tools. Need to climb? Build a ladder. Pit ahead? Stretch a chain. Tired of Robots? Burn them ALL! Gather resources across the map and don't waste a single one.

apps.name: Loot Hole
apps.short_description: Dig up your own front yard in first person, alone or with friends, and see what's buried below. Haul your finds up to the yard stall, sell them, buy better tools and dig deeper, through clay, stone and crystal caves, past secret rooms, all the way down to the Core.

apps.name: Lost Legends
apps.short_description: Lost Legends is a roguelike card game set across seven hand-painted kingdoms. Choose your Kingdom, build your deck, and explore a world that is randomly generated every run. Destroy the heart of Darkness in 7 days or the world ends.

apps.name: LuMi Desktop
apps.short_description: There's someone on your desktop now. She talks, she listens, she remembers you - and she's all yours. Her mind, her voice, her memories all live right here on your machine. No accounts, no sign-ups, internet or not. Just her, waiting for you to say hi.

apps.name: M:Brace
apps.short_description: M:Brace is a strategic real-time turn based RPG where you command powerful higher-dimensional Entities and Goddesses in battle and in bed.  You must contain the ARK but you don't need to contain yourself~

apps.name: Mage's Adventure
apps.short_description: A roguelike auto battler of misfit heroes and warped realms. Recruit your party, defeat monsters for gear, hoard godly artifacts, and put down the colossal evils at the end of every road.

apps.name: Magnet Arena
apps.short_description: Take control of the ball with magnetic power in Magnet Arena, a fast-paced sci-fi team sport. Pull, carry, and launch shots into goals worth different points, use rockets to disrupt opponents, and fight for possession across futuristic arenas.

apps.name: Marble Stars
apps.short_description: Marble Stars is a challenging platformer made by one person. Explore 55 handcrafted levels suspended above the ocean, discover special abilities, speedrun each course to compete on the global leaderboards, and earn prestigious medals as you progress.

apps.name: Meet Again: Heartwell
apps.short_description: A cozy romance and life sim set in the seaside town of Heartwell. Customize your character, decorate your room, help run your mom’s café, and build meaningful relationships as you explore town, uncover secrets, and fall in love.

apps.name: Money Trees
apps.short_description: Money Trees is a physics-driven first-person incremental experience about smacking money trees, gathering valuable coins, and throwing them into a chest. Deposit thousands of coins, buy powerful upgrades, and increase your coin collecting potential until you're making millions!

apps.name: Monsterest
apps.short_description: Manage a monster-friendly inn. Chop down trees to make furniture and decorate the rooms. Catch fish, hunt, and prepare meals. Befriend your guests, and they'll join you as companions. What kind of monster guest will visit today?

apps.name: Moonlit Cat Diner
apps.short_description: A rainy night, a little diner at the end of the alley. Cat customers take a seat, place an order, and open up as you play — six solitaire games, Shisen-Sho, and six puzzle rules. Every story you hear fills your cat codex, and every coin you earn goes into your own diner.

apps.name: MUNDU
apps.short_description: A 3D platformer for two players. Run, wall-jump and slide across six worlds with a friend, solve puzzles that need both of you and fight three giant bosses. You can play in split-screen on one PC or online.

apps.name: Muramasa: Revenant Blades
apps.short_description: Vanillaware x Marvelous present an action RPG for the ages. Hack and slash your way through a world of restless spirits and Demon Blades. The tales of six fabled protagonists of Japan's Genroku era, each with their own unique fighting style, are about to unfold.

apps.name: MUTAGEN
apps.short_description: Explore a lush, interconnected alien ecosystem that reshapes itself each time you die. Absorb mutations from your fallen kin to reach new areas and adapt to your surroundings. Study the environment to find your own solutions, and unearth the planet's many secrets.

apps.name: Nib Unleashed
apps.short_description: Nib Unleashed is a cosmic incremental shooter. You play as Nib, a hungry little space alien who snacks on rocks. Blast through endless swarms of rocky foes and unlock new weapons, slicker moves and wilder ways to attack. Turns out the rocks don't like being eaten, so expect heavy resistance.

apps.name: Nightbound
apps.short_description: Two strangers share one house at the end of the world. Their only hope: trust each other, fix up a van, and reach a mountain too cold for the Bloom to follow. You fight as a pair with turn-based tactics. Live the days together, hold the house at night, and build a bond that outgrows the Bloom.

apps.name: Nitrania
apps.short_description: Race. Boost. Unlock. A blazing-fast 90s-inspired arcade grip racer with 4-player split-screen. Master nitro to overtake 19 rivals, collect points, and unlock cars, upgrades, and vibrant track regions. Featuring an original soundtrack by the legendary retro racing composer BARRY LEITCH.

apps.name: No Parole
apps.short_description: Up to 16 players, one prison, friendly fire on. Raid a city where the dead keep growing, haul the loot home, fortify your cell block and hold the walls on day 30, when the government comes to bury the evidence. Your crew dies for good. You don't. You just don't know why yet.

apps.name: Normandie
apps.short_description: Normandie is a narrative ocean crawler set in the wake of World War II. Suit up as Charlie, a rookie salvage diver aboard the Shomesh. Work with your crew to explore the wrecks of the legendary ocean liners that once ruled the Atlantic.

apps.name: Nuria's Redemption
apps.short_description: How many waves of rabid babies could you survive? Join your friends in Nuria's Redemption, a frantic co-op and PvP shooter. Choose from 4 classes, level up in combat, and defend your base from random events. Save the timeline!

apps.name: OmOchim
apps.short_description: Build machines, contraptions and playgrounds out of everyday objects in a physics sandbox driven by visual programming. Overcome obstacles, save the city, create worlds. Every goal has a dozen answers. Every crash, collapse and explosion is just the next idea.

apps.name: One duck too many
apps.short_description: A tiny bathtub sits on top of your taskbar with one duck in it. Its bubbles hatch more ducks, those ducks hatch more, and soon they spill over the rim and wander across your desktop. A desktop companion with 30 ducks to discover, born from the water's temperature, the night and each other.

apps.name: Oomi’s Nook
apps.short_description: Oomi’s Nook is a cozy and relaxing sticker decor game. Decorate a little room with hand-drawn style stickers according to the drawing or unleash your creativity! Follow the lighthearted everyday life of the adorable Oomi family and watch them live leisurely in the world you create!

apps.name: Operation Night Shift 2
apps.short_description: Hired by Robot Industries 12, you're promised a life-changing $1,000,000 payout for a high-risk mission. All you have to do is follow orders and survive the locations. What could possibly go wrong?

apps.name: ORC XBALLS
apps.short_description: A minor goddess running out of purpose. A people of Orcs running out of time. Your idea: replace their endless wars with a sport where anything goes. Manage your team, win the Wildlands tournaments — and repopulate the species along the way.

apps.name: Out Fishing
apps.short_description: Fish, sell, upgrade your gear, and build your camp in this first-person horror fishing game. Explore a haunted forest and uncover clues about a forgotten disappearance near the lake, but return before nightfall, as danger lurks beneath the water.

apps.name: Outpost Incursions
apps.short_description: Use upgradeable turrets and roguelite progression to face hordes of enemies on alien planets.

apps.name: OVERCLOCK: Neon Survival Protocol
apps.short_description: A top-down neon roguelite. Survive hordes for six minutes, pick 1 of 3 upgrades on every level-up, trigger Overdrive and bring down the Overseer Prime. Credits buy permanent upgrades and new cores.

apps.name: OwnMe: Kira
apps.short_description: An explicit femdom JOI game. Kira, a gothic domme, tells you when to stroke, how fast, when to stop and whether you get to cum at all. Edge for her, beg for release, obey or pay for it. She remembers how you behave and can take over your sex toy.

apps.name: Pathfinding
apps.short_description:
Every day is a new chance to rise to the top of the leaderboard!
Dodge those filthy squares, push your reflexes to the limit, and prove you’ve got what it takes to see the Matrix.
Only the sharpest players will survive long enough to claim the crown.
Can you outlast them all and become the one?

apps.name: Phantom Demon Siege
apps.short_description: Survive monsters and supernatural creatures in an intense third-person shooter. Explore corrupted environments, find weapons, and fight to escape the collapsing world.

apps.name: PhantomFumes
apps.short_description: A noir visual novel where you tie your memories back together to solve the mystery. Help him on his journey to uncover the secrets of this case. Find clues and evidence and draw the strings together with them to find a red thread straight to the truth. There will be jokes, hopes and plenty of smoke.

apps.name: Phonophobia
apps.short_description: Explore unsettling, dark locations in a first-person psychological horror adventure. Restore power grids, solve environmental puzzles, and interact with physical objects to navigate through the dark—where sound is your only guide and greatest threat.

apps.name: Piece Makers
apps.short_description: Piece Makers is a first person shooter where you need to find parts in order to build your own weapons.

apps.name: Play Strikers
apps.short_description: Everyone deserves to play football. Play Strikers is a football video game that combines club management, squad building, and tactical decision-making with direct control of your players in our 3D match engine.

apps.name: Poker Night Live
apps.short_description: Real No-Limit Texas Hold’em with your friends — live webcam and voice chat right at the table. Seat up to 7 friends online, or play solo against Easy, Medium and Hard bots anytime.

apps.name: Ponchyo: A Platypus Adventure
apps.short_description: Ponchyo: A Platypus Adventure is a charming 3D platformer collectathon full of adventure - and a hint of nostalgia! Play as Ponchyo the platypus and journey through a variety of vibrant worlds. Collect coins and discover new furniture to decorate your home.

apps.name: Poppets & Plunder
apps.short_description: Sail a cutaway brig through four seas of Navy gunships, witch-hunters and Company gold. Run the crew deck by deck, work the guns, and when you are outgunned, reach for the voodoo doll and push a pin into the enemy ship. A roguelite of real-time fights and costly magic.

apps.name: Power Showdown
apps.short_description:
Power Showdown is a turn-based tactical superhero strategy game where positioning, powers, terrain, and team composition determine every battle.Build a squad from a growing collection of heroes and villains.
Build your team. Master your powers. Win the showdown.

apps.name: PRESIDENT
apps.short_description: Become President… or end up the Asshole! PRESIDENT brings the famous card game to life with 11 modes, five AI difficulty levels and multiplayer. Challenge your friends or compete in tournaments with up to 16 participants to claim the crown!

apps.name: Pro Football Dynasty
apps.short_description: The ultimate American football management sim. Call plays, sign free agents, scout prospects, draft superstars, and dive into deep stats for every player and team. Take control as a coach or GM, chase championships, and build a storied dynasty.

apps.name: Pry Into The Void
apps.short_description: Delve into the hearts of monsters and people in this bleak monster-taming RPG. Exploit enemy weaknesses, confront difficult moral choices, and recruit surreal creatures by uncovering the truths hidden within their souls.

apps.name: PumpUp Fugu
apps.short_description: Tap a PumpUp Fugu and it puffs up in a huff — use that to shove the Fugu Queen out through the coral wall and set her free! 160 hand-built levels, plus more once you have cleared them. An action physics puzzler with times worth chasing.

apps.name: Push Their Buttons
apps.short_description: Everyone in town has a button. Chat up the locals, work out what they care about, and push it at just the right moment for a rant, a good cry or a misty-eyed memory. Duel rivals in quick games, go fishing, bring lost pets home and beat the crowd to the best conversations.

apps.name: Queued for Destruction
apps.short_description: A zombie defense game with a vast skill tree and weapons you can fuse and enhance. Combine attributes and modifications, build your firepower, and kill thousands, tens of thousands, or even a million zombies. Unlock nuclear strikes, choose a target, and clear the horde with one click.

apps.name: RADMINTON
apps.short_description: Become a super rad parkour vigilante and fight back against ADCO. Experience over-the-top action and comical gunfights against 'the big corpo' as you traverse through movement-based levels and puzzles. A 3D-action parkour movement shooter where you can customize, style, rebel, and keep it RAD!

apps.name: Realm of Iron
apps.short_description: Realm of Iron is a dark fantasy pixel-art action RPG for solo or co-op with up to 8 friends. Explore a vast continent, clear dungeons and slay bosses, craft and refine your gear, then farm, fish, cook and build a town while living settlements trade, raid and go to war around you.

apps.name: RealRTCW
apps.short_description: RealRTCW is an overhaul mod for critically acclaimed Wolfenstein classic. It features improved visuals, expanded arsenal, rebalanced gunplay and proper modern systems support!

apps.name: Reign of Arrows
apps.short_description: A minimalist roguelite about taking back your throne. Recruit thousands of archers, choose powerful upgrades, and discover game breaking builds to destroy the false king's armies!

apps.name: REKINDLE: Dark Tidy Up
apps.short_description: You just bought the old house of a compulsive hoarder. By the light of a lighter, with rain on the roof, put everything back on its shelf. No timer, no game over: just a calm evening in the dark, and a presence that watches you but will never harm you.

apps.name: Road Rash™: 30th Anniversary Edition
apps.short_description: Road Rash, the franchise which defined the combat racing genre, returns in the first ever digital version of the game. This 30th Anniversary Edition includes a fully relicensed soundtrack, higher resolution cinematics, up to 60 FPS gameplay, and more.

apps.name: Rockblaze
apps.short_description: Rockblaze is a 2.5D physics-based puzzle platformer. Move with thrusters or weapon recoil as you pilot your ship through a simulated futuristic prison. Upgrade your ship, experiment with builds, learn from failure, and uncover the secrets of the simulation.

apps.name: Rogue Roulette
apps.short_description: Become the ultimate gambling god in this roulette roguelike. Create busted builds and get filthy rich. Victory and failure are just one spin away.

apps.name: Romance of the Three Kingdoms Hadou [JP]
Salty
apps.short_description:
A lone spark of life, one fragile cell adrift in a vast, chaotic world.
Feed, grow, adapt, outmaneuver predators, survive viral invasions, and assemble new organelles that reshape your abilities and your destiny. You're learning the science the whole time, too immersed in survival to notice.

apps.name: Salva's Chess
apps.short_description: Chess in 2D and 3D that plays just as well with a controller as with a mouse, and also from any browser. Six AI levels with titles to earn, game reviews that explain every mistake, puzzles, an interactive tutorial and online play.

apps.name: Sand Eaters
apps.short_description:
Experience SAND EATERS, a sci-fi game where evolution fuels an endless interstellar struggle. Forge your own path through a universe reshaped by life and machine, and discover what you become...
 CREATE | DESTROY | EVOLVE

apps.name: Scrap Slot Arena
apps.short_description: Spin a slot machine built from scrap, and the five parts it lands on become your robot. Reroll up to twice, then watch a 15-second physics brawl unfold. Win and your machine fights on; lose and it is back to junk. Topple three leagues and their Kings to relight the last arena.

apps.name: Shades of Fear - North Loop
apps.short_description: Shades of Fear - North Loop is a first-person psychological horror game inspired by a true story. In October 2004, four old friends plan a weekend of camping on a trail they've known since they were kids. Not everyone on the trail is there to camp.

apps.name: Shaype
apps.short_description: Shaype is a singleplayer fantasy action role-playing game with an emphasis on player agency, character progression, engaging combat, interactive dialogue, and player-driven narratives.

apps.name: Shelterra the Skyworld
apps.short_description: Explore a floating continent in a fantasy JRPG! Journey across an open world, conquer dungeons in turn-based battles, learn new skills by fighting enemies, and summon powerful Artifacts to aid you. Uncover the secrets of the Skyworld and save Shelterra from falling!

apps.name: Shove Nova
apps.short_description: Shove Nova is a fast-paced 2D physics arena game where you grow your energy sphere, use powerful abilities, and smash rivals out of a shrinking battlefield. Master chaotic arenas filled with portals, black holes, bounce walls, and other hazards as you fight to be the last one standing.

apps.name: Sixshooters: A 6 Player Split-Screen FPS
apps.short_description: Six players, one couch, one screen or jump online with a server browser. Check out this highly customizable split-screen arena shooter with bright colorful graphics. Complete with ten game modes, bots with personalities, face importing tool, and all you need to make share and download arenas online.

apps.name: SKEFs Night Grill
apps.short_description:
You work the night shift at a burger joint in a crime-ridden neighborhood. Serve customers, prepare food, and try to survive the night.

But there's a problem. Not everyone who walks up to your window is human.

apps.name: Slidebound
apps.short_description: Slidebound is a puzzle game with simple rules, but it's way more complicated than it seems at first glance. Can you get the red circles into the goal? Watch out, they are very slippery and won't stop before they hit something. Use as few moves as possible to get 3 stars on hundreds of levels.

apps.name: Sloppy Forgeries
apps.short_description: Sloppy Forgeries is a fast-paced competitive painting game. Practice your skills by butchering iconic masterpieces in one of the few drawing games that measures accuracy pixel-by-pixel in real-time.

apps.name: Slots of Chaos - Melee Arena
apps.short_description: Chop up your friends and enemies in an enclosed arena with random chaos modes driven by a slot machine.

apps.name: Smart Fellas
apps.short_description: Octopuses hide in plain sight on a sunlit reef: copy any surface, strike a pose, sneak a snack when no one's looking. Divers hunt them with a one-shot spear gun. Smart Fellas vs Fart Smellas, up to 32 players online.

apps.name: Snow of Penglai
apps.short_description:
Snow of Penglai is a yuri-themed visual novel set in ancient China. Players will step into the shoes of Xuanhua, a puppet girl, and confront everything about the witch Zhu Hanchuan.
This is a story of rebirth. A lotus rising, bleeding, blooming anew.

apps.name: Sort The Mart
apps.short_description: Sort The Mart is a cozy organizing simulator where you sort hundreds of toys, food, cars, plushies, sports items, and more onto the correct shelves. Enjoy the satisfying process of turning a messy mart into a perfectly organized store, one shelf at a time, at your own pace.

apps.name: Soul Dust
apps.short_description: Soul Dust is a third-person bullet action heaven rogue-lite where you set the tempo. Go full hands-on action, lean purely into passive power builds, or mix it up. No matter how you tune your control, the goal is always the same. Survive the onslaught and break the game.

apps.name: Soul Snake 3D
apps.short_description: Slither through seven cursed biomes as a snake that grows into a weapon. Eat prey, auto-fire venom darts, and build a run from 68 upgrade cards and 9 evolutions. Topple each biome's guardian, bank souls for permanent upgrades, and see how long you last in endless Survival.

apps.name: Sound Agent 声探疑云
apps.short_description: Sound Agent is a narrative puzzle game where you solve cold cases by listening. Use the sound device to rewind to crime scenes, listen to the sounds at the scene, and uncover truths hidden in plain sound.

apps.name: SpellChain
apps.short_description: Create and combine your own spells through a dynamic spellcrafting system. Fight through a hostile kingdom, disrupt its events and grow your magical powers on a quest to slay the king.

apps.name: Spike Force
apps.short_description: Spike Force is a roguelite deckbuilder soaked in 90's action anime. Build your volleyball team, draft your cards, and represent your school in a supernatural battle for the fate of humanity. Every match is a fight for survival, and every card is a move in the game.

apps.name: Stained Blade
apps.short_description: Feel the weight of a blade in the first physics-based melee multiplayer VR combat game. Duel or fight as a team in 1v1 or 3v3 driven by real physic and real skill. Don the armor of 12 unique classes with their own combat style. Rise through the ranks in a gothic battleground.

apps.name: StalSide
apps.short_description: Trapped inside a broken computer simulation of a post‑nuclear world, you must survive, explore, and uncover the secrets of the zone. Play solo or with up to 8 friends in this chilling mix of survival and digital mystery.

apps.name: Starfallen: Strength
apps.short_description:
Welcome to the Sky Ward, a fortress built with the purpose of discovering the mysteries of magic on the pangea Aelyria.

As Lennon and Petra, who serve the Sky Ward. Explore and unveil the mysteries of the world, defend it, and fall in love along the way.

apps.name: Study With Me: Online
apps.short_description: Your new favorite place to study. Create an avatar and share a cozy multiplayer library with friends while you work on real-life goals. Mix 80+ clothing and footwear options, bring your books and music, then unwind with coffee or chess.

apps.name: Subway: 0% Escape
apps.short_description: With over 2 million downloads, this smash-hit suspense visual novel arrives on PC! Your choices determine the fate of 14 passengers trapped on a runaway subway train. With a killer in your midst, can you survive the paranoia and escape? Play the complete edition uninterrupted!

apps.name: SUMOWBALL
apps.short_description: Roll, grow, and knock your opponents off the island in this physics-based multiplayer party game. Master momentum, build the biggest snowball, and be the last penguin standing.

apps.name: Super Emoji Murder Death God Labyrinth
apps.short_description: I made a little turn-based puzzle game out of free emoji. Grab the gems, reach the exit, stay out of the guards’ way. Simple! Except something got into my levels, and it keeps moving things while you play. So I drew you some tools: Cut, Copy, Paste and Nudge. Edit them back.

apps.name: Survive 'Til Dawn!
apps.short_description: Team up or go solo as tower defence strategy meets fast-paced action! Scavenge a wonderfully wrecked wasteland for scrap, build ridiculous death machines, and jump into the fight yourself to hold back increasingly deadly mutant hordes. Can you survive 'til dawn?

apps.name: Sus Squad
apps.short_description: A online party game for 5–14 friends. Do your tasks, team up on a big global mission and vote out the impostor with the knife — before they get you. A haunted mansion, a western ghost town, Hot Potato and a whole playground to mess around in. Trust no one.

apps.name: Sweet Furniture
apps.short_description: Sweet Furniture - A simple and beautiful jigsaw puzzle game themed around furniture. Enjoy the pleasant time spent in a furniture store with five pretty and cute girls, accompanied by relaxing music. After completing a level, you can admire the girls' photos in the gallery.

apps.name: Swoopla: Swing Racing
apps.short_description: Fire a line at a building, let go, and fly. Swing, glide and ski through twelve stages, from a neon interchange and a clockwork tower city to a 600 m megatower and a deep-sea aquarium, in a fast 3D swing racer.

apps.name: Tallymark
apps.short_description: A third-person survival roguelite in an endless, overgrown city. One life: sneak, scavenge, craft on the move and fight with scarce bullets and brutal melee. Get inside before dark, hold out when the swarm comes every seventh night, and scratch one more mark on the wall.

apps.name: Tattie Bogle
apps.short_description: You are the scarecrow. On a small farm at the edge of the woods, a Tomte's magic pulled you off your post and gave you a job: keep the harvest alive. Can you turn the place around before it all falls apart? A challenging fairytale roguelite, solo or 2-4 player online co-op.

apps.name: Tavern on the Old Road
apps.short_description: The only bar left on the old road is a curious place. You're the bartender. Chat with the rare guests who've found their way here. Mix them fulfilling drinks accompanied by ASMR-grade soundscapes. Will you solve the mysteries of a world inspired by magical realism?

apps.name: TepuLink
apps.short_description: Form spiritual bonds with Tepus in a 2D online creature RPG. Explore a persistent world, battle with your active companion, study wild creatures, form new bonds, grow your collection, and share the adventure with other Summoners.

apps.name: Terra Trials
apps.short_description: Survive a brutal reality show on a dangerous alien planet! Start with basic tools, build shelter, and face deadly trials and boss battles. Earn points to unlock new items and helpers. Explore, craft, and survive in a procedurally generated world full of threats and surprises!

apps.name: Terraforming Mars Simulator
apps.short_description: Stranded alone on Mars. Mine iron and ice with a tactile beam, rebuild a broken colony, and survive the freezing night on stored sunlight and rationed oxygen — while a sandworm's dust plume crawls the horizon. An austere low-poly survival builder about earning your way home.

apps.name: The Big Grab
apps.short_description: Come on down, Contestant! Dash into this incremental game about a massive supermarket shopping spree. Grab as many items as you can in short runs before the buzzer sounds. Upgrade your cart, your speed, your ratings, unlock costumes, and master new store floors to win the big prize!

apps.name: The Boba Teashop – Refill
apps.short_description: The Boba Teashop - Refill is a first-person psychological horror game. Work at a new branch of Risa's boba shop as Maya, prepare drinks, serve customers, and survive increasingly disturbing shifts where routines slowly turn into a nightmare.

apps.name: The Box Project
apps.short_description: A short first-person experimental comedy game. A voice believes modern players have become worse, and he has designed a simple test to prove it. Your task: supervise a box and prove you are a good player.

apps.name: The False Alice -Retold Tale-
apps.short_description: This is the trash can where all failed works gather. When you awaken, you come across three false Alices. In order to become the one true Alice, they attempt to kill each other. Who will become the real Alice? This is a visual novel where your decisions, will change the ending of the story.

apps.name: THE FIRST ZOMBIE
apps.short_description: Play as humanity's very first zombie! In this unique zombie game, you don't kill the undead—you multiply them. "Make friends" with humans to grow your horde and transform Tokyo into a city of zombies!
developers: THE FIRST ZOMBIE 製作委員会
publishers: THE FIRST ZOMBIE 製作委員会

apps.name: The Forbidden Tome and the Enchanted Labyrinth
apps.short_description:
A lazy mage is imprisoned by a forbidden book inside a labyrinth filled with erotic creations.
This is both a punishment and a trial.
Experience a top-down roguelike shooter featuring pixel animations, HD CG, and Live2D—all in one thrilling adventure.

apps.name: The INDIGO Initiative
apps.short_description: A first-person puzzle adventure where you harness fire, water, electricity, and magnetism to solve multi-step puzzles and explore atmospheric realms to restore balance before reality collapses.

apps.name: The Last Grave Job
apps.short_description: Online co-op horror for up to 4 players. Sneak into a cemetery at night, find the right graves, dig up the loot and haul it back to your wheelbarrow. Stay quiet, avoid the Keeper and get out alive.

apps.name: The LastShard
apps.short_description: Make a life in the last world still lit. The LastShard is a high-fantasy sandbox MMO with skills learned by use, player crafting and trade, open-world housing, magic, taming and sailing. Beyond guarded towns, open PvP and full loot make every journey a choice.

apps.name: The Pool Problem
apps.short_description: Fill the world's biggest pool... one spoonful at a time. Haul water from your neighbor's sea, upgrade from a spoon to pipes and waterfalls, keep the water clean and turn your backyard into a pool empire. Play solo or with up to 4 friends.

apps.name: The Resonance Initiative
apps.short_description: In this open-world factory sandbox you need to harness unique power waveforms to run your machines. Use everything as fuel, from plant life to fallen enemies. Explore the world to uncover new foes and resources to exploit as your empire grows.

apps.name: the tell
apps.short_description: An adult visual novel with a stats system. An experimental retinal lens shows the pulse, arousal and unspoken thoughts of the three women around you. Over 22 in-game days you decide whom to read, whom to confront and whom to choose. Three routes, seven endings, animated adult scenes.

apps.name: The Top Game
apps.short_description: Enter a deadly prison survival game where every choice and every QTE can mean life or death. Follow Lin Yu through four ruthless levels in a cinematic interactive thriller where one mistake could end everything.

apps.name: The unwinnable fight of Debuffs against Succubi
apps.short_description: When we arrived at the Demon King's castle, a group of succubi stopped us! Because of the "Debuffs" they give, we can't hold onto our sanity...

apps.name: The Way of Wrath
apps.short_description: Forge your path as a Bronze Age tribal chieftain in this epic strategy RPG. Lead your tribe in a fight for survival against all odds as the elements, time, and a relentless foe seek to wipe your people out.

apps.name: TIAN NUO
apps.short_description:
Easy to Learn. Instantly Accessible.
Simple Mechanics. Endless Possibilities.
Epic Dungeons. Diverse Character Builds.
Enter a world of ancient myths, legendary heroes, and timeless traditions.
Join players from around the globe and discover the epic legends of the East.

apps.name: Till the End
apps.short_description: Earth has fallen. Recruit survivors in the ruins, activate their unique Power Suits, and fight back against endless alien hordes in this solo-developed sci-fi roguelite wave shooter. Master Bushido blades, Centurion tanks, or Magi blasts — become unstoppable.

apps.name: TIMEMOON
apps.short_description: This cab is a time machine. Become a cab driver on the moon and solve the mystery of the president's assassination in this sci-fi time travel visual novel.

apps.name: Tooth & Tide
apps.short_description: Search tropical shores for shark teeth, craft necklaces, and grow your island museum and shop. Follow the tides across multiple islands, discover 50 collectible species, and settle into the changing rhythms of Tooth & Tide.

apps.name: TOUCHSTARVED
apps.short_description: TOUCHSTARVED is a dark romance visual novel where your choices determine whether the story ends with gothic romance or blood-curdling horror. Explore an enigmatic city and find a cure for your curse by entrusting your fate to 5 love interests, each uniquely monstrous in their own way.

apps.name: Touhou: Don't Spill It!
apps.short_description: Carry a jar brimming with water to the shrine - alone, or with a friend on the other handle. A Touhou Project fan game of wobbly water physics and steady hands: every bump, gust and hasty step spills a little, and the water left in the jar is your score.

apps.name: Tradeways
apps.short_description: Pave, trade, prosper! Lay the trade roads that make a kingdom. Found villages on the land's riches, send caravans to feed a growing town, guard the roads from bandits, and pay a sovereign whose tribute rises every year. How long will your city last?

apps.name: Traffic Check
apps.short_description: An arcade racer where traffic is your weapon. Slam cars into each other, drift, boost and keep scoring even after you crash. Every map is procedurally generated, with new highways, biomes, towns and back roads to tear through, solo or up to 4-player splitscreen. Never stop burning

apps.name: Trash
apps.short_description: A co-op adventure crafting game where you restore balance to a trashy world. Jump, Glide, Shield or Smash your way around a wild open world, complete procedurally generated challenge zones, interact with rubbish creatures and customise your character with crafted forms & abilities.

apps.name: Tungsten Moon
apps.short_description: First-person 3D spaceflight sim on a tungsten moon. Master accurate rocket physics in a vast, open world that shows no mercy, while a shadowy figure tries to help you survive. Or do they want you dead?

apps.name: ULTRACRACK
apps.short_description: A free word puzzle where a wall of letters slides toward the CRACK line. Spell words with ANY letters on the board to pop them, but every word pushes the wall closer! A 100-level Campaign, a new Daily Challenge every day, Endless and Ultra modes, power-ups, rooms and pets.

apps.name: UNDEFEATED: Genesis
apps.short_description: Become the hero Voltissia needs. Fly freely across a vast alien planet, master extraordinary superpowers, and battle ferocious mutants in an expansive superhero action RPG.

apps.name: Vein-Weaver Knitting
apps.short_description: Activate, Jump, Bomb, Out Run, Get Power Ups, Find Hidden Items, Speed Run, Pull Levers, Activate Switches, Out Smart Enemies, And Unravel The Story And Destroy The Dimension Crafted By An Ancient Craft Called Vein-Weaver Knitting.

apps.name: VOICE METEOR
apps.short_description: Create spells with your voice and equip three for 5v5 battles. Mix attacks, healing, defense and disruption to support your team. Hear your own recordings become spell chants.

apps.name: VOID DIVER: Escape from the Abyss
apps.short_description: Dive into a city swallowed by the Abyss. Slay aberrations, grab artifacts, and survive until the Diving Booth arrives. A 2.5D pixel art extraction action RPG with up to 3-player co-op. Run the antique shop 'BALUSHA' and uncover the city's secrets.

apps.name: Waifu Factory
apps.short_description: This is a factory game where you manage a factory creating waifus to complete requests, buy upgrades and to grow your factory to spread love to the world.

apps.name: Waltz & Jam
apps.short_description: Waltz and Jam is a single-player action-adventure platformer following the adventures of Waltz, a pure soul, and Jam, his lovable dog companion. It is set in an afterlife born from a unique reimagination of the Seven Deadly Sins.

apps.name: WARM, BUTTERY POPCORN! WITH A SUGAR COATING!
apps.short_description: An incremental clicker about Old Joe's popcorn cart at a Brazilian cinema. Click and hold to heat the pot and catch popcorn in a bag. What you miss buries the street until a JACKPOP crank cashes it all in at up to x10. Popcorn not selling? SELL THE SPOT and keep starting over until you leave Earth!

apps.name: Water Polo: Arcade World Cup
apps.short_description: Fast, readable 7v7 arcade water polo. Pick a nation, thread passes through the defense, and outfox the keeper. Chase tournament glory, sharpen your skills in practice, or play with friends online in matches for up to eight players.

apps.name: When All Things End - 月下の万象
apps.short_description: Play as a bunny on Kagome-jima, a hand-drawn island where nothing is what it seems and your choices quietly profile who you are. Farm, forage, explore coastal shrines and fishing villages, and uncover a mystery that turns stranger the deeper you go.  Based on real bunnies.

apps.name: WordSearch Kingdom
apps.short_description: Find hidden words and unwind at your own pace. Explore 10 puzzle languages with 960 levels each, trace words in changing directions, and use a hint when you need one. No time limit, with your progress saved automatically.

apps.name: World of Awakening
apps.short_description: A single-player 3D exploration adventure across the landmark towers of the world's great cities. Walk, climb and fly around the towers of Paris, Tokyo, Shanghai, Kuala Lumpur, Auckland, the Gold Coast and New York, rebuilt from real data by day and night, and enter their awakened twin world.

apps.name: wozitdev's 3D Sniper
apps.short_description: Explore procedurally generated cities in wozitdev's take on Spector's adage of the perfect, block Imm-Sim, from behind the scope. In this fully 3-Dimensional immersive simulation you star as the titular Sniper. Drop in, roam the blocks, do as you will and take on the mantle of the Sniper's namesake.

apps.name: Yellowcake
apps.short_description: Fight your way through a post-war nuclear world by scavenging supplies, building your rocket, and taking on bosses! Explore a procedurally generated open world and find items to help you escape.

apps.name: Yo Ho Ho And A Rubber Duck
apps.short_description: Four drunken pirates in a co-op (or sabotage) open-world adventure on an inflatable ship where the biggest enemy is often your own crew.

apps.name: You Must Die
apps.short_description: Build your own dice in this turn-based roguelike! Customize individual faces, combine powerful abilities, hunt dangerous bounties, and collect new dice and relics to create devastating builds. Every face matters. Every roll counts.

apps.name: Zack Bishop and the Forbidden Moon
apps.short_description: Stranded on an alien moon, explore, fight, and craft your way home in a compact sci-fi action RPG. Master a powerful jetpack, build your arsenal, and decide who to help - or threaten - as wisecracking adventurer Zack Bishop.

apps.name: Zombies Per Minute
apps.short_description:
Zombies Per Minute is a factory-building roguelite where everything you build is measured by one thing: how many zombies you can kill per minute. Yes, really.

Use your imagination to grow your factory, make decisive choices each wave and progress from one outpost to the other. Until Earth is saved.

apps.name: Zona Eleitoral
apps.short_description: Zona Eleitoral is a turn-based strategy game that puts you in charge of a mayoral campaign. Choose your candidate, build your strategy, manage your resources to unlock new actions, and navigate unexpected twists in the race for the mayor's office. Do you have what it takes to win the election?

apps.name: ZONE L.O.S.T.
apps.short_description: YOUR BODY IS YOUR WEAKNESS. A four-player co-op horror game that puts you in the shoes of the chief scientists of a research facility. Your sole objective is to carry out the self-destruct plan and escape the facility.

apps.name: Сам Буку Пер
apps.short_description: hardcore piloting simulator with romantic elements. You will have to balance between the laws of physics and the laws of gravity. Every extra maneuver burns fuel, which separates you from the base... and from a kiss.

apps.name: ナツノカナタ ―PROLOGUE－
apps.short_description: The prologue of the novel Natsuno Kanata is now a visual novel! When Shiori boots up her late grandmother's old PC, she unexpectedly connects to a desolate alternate world ravaged by a mysterious pandemic. A post-apocalyptic adventure.

apps.name: 一起开画展
apps.short_description: Test QQ group: 909022140. Still in testing and being polished. Paint with friends, frame your work, and arrange your own gallery. Browse and collect community art, or play drawing and guessing games together.

apps.name: 人のかたちの臓花園
apps.short_description: Harvest organs from “Organblooms”—plants that look like human children and grow transplantable organs—and manage Somnus Conservatory, the facility they call home, in this morally bankrupt facility-management simulation.
publishers: クリエイターのうえきばち

apps.name: 像素骰子征服者
apps.short_description: Roll for resources and explore a randomly generated 50×50 map. Expand your territory, manage resources, and build from a catalog of 247 building blueprints. Choose troops to face enemies and bandits.

apps.name: 十四亿分之一
apps.short_description: In China, a baby is born about every four seconds, and you are the next one. Be born at random into one of 34 provinces and 56 ethnic groups, weighted by real statistics, then live one life year by year, from birth certificate to obituary. No guide. Just one life.

apps.name: 天堂残响
apps.short_description: This is an interactive horror game of twisted rules and endless survival. In a cyberpunk apocalypse, programmer Lu Heng battles five nightmare worlds, deciphers deadly traps, and uncovers the truth with tarot, cinnabar incense and a mysterious USB drive. Save himself, save her, save the world.

apps.name: 太阳骑士与邪恶试炼
apps.short_description: A single-player action RPG blending pixel art with 3D environments. Explore varied lands, master stamina-based combat, and face altar bosses and twelve demon lords. Forge your build, hatch pet companions, and rest by the campfire on a journey through loss and memory.

apps.name: 奇华幻相
apps.short_description: 这是一款包含 AIGC 玩法的二次元恋爱卡牌对战游戏。注意，游戏中的音乐，美术暂时由 AI 生成，UI，剧情，玩法由人工制作。我们并不是打算用 AI 快速打造一款游戏，而是希望打造出一款能够让玩家在游戏内自由创作，自由互动，将 AI 能力包装成玩法，从 AI 的互动中获得乐趣的游戏。游戏中你可以体验我们精心准备的剧情，与剧中的 AI NPC 互动来一定程度的改变剧情流程，也可以自由地与 NPC 交流在特殊的 AI 聊天关卡中，通过聊天与角色们创建亲密关系，最后，你还可以与这些角色们拍照，实时生成相片，还可以进一步使用这些相片来进行紧张刺激的卡牌战斗，游戏也支持与玩家的 PVP 战斗噢。

apps.name: 宝石勇者
apps.short_description: Descend into a malice-soaked underworld in this intensely oppressive single-player "loot, fight, extract" roguelite deckbuilder. Play as a Stone Folk hero, battling monsters in a grotesque gamble. Build your deck mid-run, scavenge eyeballs and skulls, dissect bosses for mystery rewards.

apps.name: 寒伶：北齐流民录
apps.short_description: Set in China's Northern and Southern Dynasties, HanLing is a dark visual novel blending history, mystery, folklore, and multiple endings. Buried secrets, blood debts, and loved ones' hidden pasts entwine every fate. When salvation and sin come from the same hands, how will you face the truth?

apps.name: 封印迷宮の勇者
apps.short_description: An auto-battle RPG about collecting gear and growing stronger. Support your hero with click attacks, unlock sword skills and magic, and upgrade equipment at the blacksmith. Push deeper into the labyrinth or repeat floors to prepare. Rethink your build and challenge enemies again.

apps.name: 开拓物语
apps.short_description: Frontier Tale is a cozy adventure farming game that blends extraction-style gameplay with town building. Forge weapons, explore a charming cel-shaded fantasy world, gather rare resources, recruit unique companions, and build your dream frontier from the ground up.

apps.name: 忒伊亚：灵魂之塔
apps.short_description: This is a deck-building strategy game built around the core mechanics of RPS, featuring a free-roaming exploration system and mini games that blend elements of Tetris and Minesweeper. It is a relaxing, collection-focused title with light roguelike elements.
developers: 上海吉蒂恩科技发展有限公司
publishers: 上海吉蒂恩科技发展有限公司

apps.name: 无双屠龙
apps.short_description: 《无双屠龙》是一款回归纯粹打宝与PK的微变传奇。所有装备全爆，地图无VIP限制，散人友好。核心玩法包括：多大陆解锁、四象神装、元神、八门、灵器等深度养成系统。特色属性包含百分比切割、斩杀、鞭尸，大幅提升BOSS击杀效率。通过沙城捐献、首充双倍、VIP超值礼包快速成长，限时首爆奖励灵符，平民也能霸服。超多BOSS、混沌之地、封魔录等挑战等你来战。

apps.name: 无尽之地
apps.short_description: 无尽之地由一克游戏品牌开发，是无尽之路的正统续作，该款为第三人称闯关游戏，进入游戏后玩家需要用“W,S,A,D键”控制主角的“上,下,左,右”，L键为攻击键，K键为奔跑，与宠物猫对话即可切换主角(莱斯德·金)，与宠物狗对话即可切换主角(埃·金)，ent回车键为交互键进行人物的对话和事件的发生，ESC为菜单栏键，游戏里还有商店功能，与商人对话即可进入商店页面，初始默认男主为埃·金，使用枪手闯关更为容易。
publishers: 中国一克集团股份有限公司

apps.name: 明末：力挽狂澜
apps.short_description: 正在尝试让地图大战略+AI模拟结合，看看能碰撞出怎样的火花，游戏支持传统大战略地图策略模拟的大部分要素，同时让AI替代了核心的摇骰子阶段，让游戏的自由度更上一层楼。科技，国策，人物，势力以及几乎所有的一切，不再局限于开发者的预设条目和节点。

apps.name: 決勝棒球 Baseballball
apps.short_description: A baseball-focused sports career and life simulation game. Start as a 16-year-old high school player, pitch, bat, run bases, and field while balancing school, daily life, part-time jobs, and investments. Go pro, try other sports, and compete against AI or friends.

apps.name: 洞府修仙录
apps.short_description: 经营一座破落宗门：安排弟子种田炼丹、静修冲境，给他们赐婚、看他们生子、也看他们记仇。布阵迎战同样在过日子的敌宗，熬过每五十年一次的大劫。二十个建造位，九品仙宗，六处秘境——飞升，或者被灭门。

apps.name: 琥珀末日
apps.short_description: Amber of The End is a strategic card-based RPG. Dong Yue, about to start his second year of university, finds himself trapped in a time loop and reliving this unusual autumn.Meet intriguing friends, build unique card decks, defeat strong enemies, and find the truth hidden at the end of this autumn.
developers: SUAN JIANG GUO Network Technology Co., LTD
publishers: SUAN JIANG GUO Network Technology Co., LTD

apps.name: 異界ノ宿帳
apps.short_description: Run an inn in the Otherworld, where forgotten things become tsukumogami. By day, tend to guests burdened by Kegare. By night, survive the horrors born from the impurity left behind. Your choices shape the guests’ healing and the inn’s fate.

apps.name: 罗森图鉴Online
apps.short_description: 欢迎来到《罗森图鉴Online》！这是一款由个人制作的MMORPG，持续更新中。

apps.name: 荒野与进化
apps.short_description: Lead a primitive tribe through a ruthless wilderness. Gather, craft, hunt, and migrate to survive beasts, disasters, and plagues. Earn inventions and evolution points to grow your people and ignite the dawn of civilization.

apps.name: 重启：工作日
apps.short_description: Welcome to MirrorTech. During your 7-day probation, clock in on time, obey the rules, and test an AI. Strange coworkers and a desk you cannot leave await. Work is your only comfort—but at night, will you uncover its secrets? Every choice shapes everyone’s fate. Survive your probation!

apps.name: 骤影：绯月杀
apps.short_description: Among Shadows is an intense blend of fast-paced combat and social deduction. You are sent to stop a deadly infection from spreading across a corrupted land, but traitors have infiltrated your team. As the Blood Moon rises, can you uncover the traitors and escape before it’s too late?

apps.name: 신체 미용사의 기이한 일상
apps.short_description: Bizarre and brutal events unfold at a secluded hair salon. Experience a story-driven blend of gore, black comedy, and crime across 12 chapters, with approximately 4 hours of playtime. Available in Korean only.

apps.name: Steam Frame
apps.short_description:
Your games in every dimension
Wireless, comfortable, lightweight VR for your Steam library

apps.name: THE KING OF FIGHTERS '97 GLOBAL MATCH Soundtrack
apps.short_description:
THE KING OF FIGHTERS '97 GLOBAL MATCH OST features a total of 41 tracks for your listening pleasure.
Enjoy music from the final chapter of the KOF OROCHI Saga.
This soundtrack collection was remastered by SNK's Sound Team themselves from an actual NEOGEO console. Enjoy!
Includes MP3/FLAC files.

apps.name: VOID/BREAKER Soundtrack
apps.short_description: Own the official music of VOID/BREAKER, created by Joe Ford.

apps.name: でびるコネクショん Original Sound Track
apps.short_description: This is the official soundtrack to the world of "Devil Connection".

apps.name: After Hours Neon Lights Game Server
